metadata.description: Claude Code plugin for persistent triage dialogue with OpenAI Codex CLI — same-thread review/plan conversations via `codex exec resume`.

plugins.name: cc-codex-triage
plugins.description: Persistent named Codex CLI threads for open-ended cross-agent triage. Adds /codex-review, /codex-plan, /codex-thread commands plus a skill that frames cross-agent feedback in Judge mode to suppress sycophantic capitulation.
